verdict.rationale: Cerebras provides extensive first-party API docs (quickstart, OpenAI-compatible endpoints, SDKs for Python/Node, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs, batch API, dedicated endpoints), and community evidence confirms real developers integrating it into agents, Cursor, and custom apps via the documented API/SDKs. Missing for 10: a discoverable formal OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found only 404s at standard paths) and more independent API-reliability corroboration beyond scattered rate-limit complaints.
